senses.gloss: m. ch. (= h. שַׁכָּף; שכף, √כף, cmp. אוּכָּף) worker in leather, saddler, shoemaker.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 112a:6">Sabb. 112ᵃ</cite> the travellers’ sandals <he>דקטרי א׳</he> which the shoemakers knot (tightly).
<cite ref="Shabbat 104b:3">Ib. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>חרתא דא׳</he> the blacking used by shoemakers.
<cite ref="Shabbat 123b:7">Ib. 123ᵇ</cite> <he>חרבא דא׳</he> the leather dressers’ knife.
